ValidationRule.description: Check to see that the minimum requirements are entered when creating a Contact record. A user must fill out these required fields in order to save the Contact: First Name, Last Name, and Email or Phone.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
/* Requires First and Last Name, as well as Phone or Email to be populated */
AND( ISNew(), $Setup.Validation_Rule_Exception__c.Run_Validation_Rule__c, OR( ISBLANK ( FirstName ), ISBLANK ( LastName ), AND( ISBLANK ( Email ), ISBLANK ( Phone ), ISBLANK ( HomePhone ), ISBLANK ( MobilePhone ), ISBLANK ( OtherPhone ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must fill out these required fields in order to save the Contact: First Name, Last Name, and either Phone or Email.
